sections.title: General
sections.text:
Version, updates, what's new and privacy.
- About: Version, license and source repository.
- Check for updates on launch: Look for a newer release when the manager opens.
- Check for updates now: Ask GitHub for the latest release.
- Open What's new after an update: Show the release notes once, the first time the manager opens on a new version.
- Share anonymous usage stats: Let the Community tab count page views, installs and publishes on the community site.

sections.title: Appearance
sections.text:
How the manager looks on this device.
- Theme: Dark, light, or follow the system.
- Accent color: The highlight color used for buttons, links and selection.
- Density: Spacing and control height across the manager.
- Sidebar: Show the navigation with labels, or as icons only.
- Start page: What the manager opens to.
- Reduce motion: Turn animations and transitions off in the manager.

sections.title: Editing
sections.text:
How the module editors behave.
- Keep empty tag groups: Keep a tag group with no tags when saving a wildcard.
- Sub-categories panel: Whether the sub-categories panel opens on its own in the wildcard editor.

sections.title: Autocomplete
sections.text:
Suggestions while you type option values.
- Booru tags: Danbooru tag names while you type option values.
- LoRAs: Installed LoRA names, inserted as <lora:name:1.0>.
- Embeddings: Installed embedding names.
- Append ", " after a pick: Follow each completion with a comma and a space.
- Max suggestions: How many tag suggestions the popup lists.
- Minimum characters: Letters typed before tag suggestions appear.

sections.title: Canvas
sections.text:
The nodes on the ComfyUI canvas, and how runs resolve.
- Ref recursion limit: How deep nested @{uuid} references resolve when a workflow runs.
- Module density: Module spacing and chip sizes.
- Decoration: Gradients & shadows. Off = flat (weak GPU / remote desktop).
- Color intensity: How saturated accent / kind / status colors render. Muted reduces chroma for a calmer palette; vivid bumps it for pop.
- Type style: How the kind indicator shows on module rows AND bundle headers: chip text, icon glyph, or both.
- State indicator style: How mod / missing / drift / conflict markers appear.
- State border highlights: Color the module border by its state.
- Collapse new modules by default: Modules added via the picker render with body hidden (header only). Bundles have their own setting below.
- Collapse new bundles by default: Bundles inserted from the library render with the frame collapsed (header only). Independent from the modules collapse-default since bundles usually carry 3-8 children and users often want a different default there.
- Collapse stack mode: Independent: each module collapses on its own. Accordion: expanding a module collapses all others.
- Focus mode: Hover a module to dim the others.
- New modules start disabled: When on, modules added from the picker start with their toggle off. Useful when configuring before letting them run.
- Confirm destructive bundle actions: Show a confirm dialog before remove / reset-to-library / save-to-library on bundles. Turn off if you trust the Undo toast as the only safety net.
- Bundle master toggle: clear behavior: What the bundle master ON->OFF click clears. Preserve manual: only revert rows the master itself turned on; rows the user marked internal / locked individually stay put. Cascade: clear every applicable row regardless of how it got set. Applicability (skip constraint for internal, skip non-lockable for lock) is hardcoded — the engine ignores the flag on those kinds, so writing it would be dead data.
- Validation strictness: How aggressively the conflict scanner surfaces issues. Permissive turns it off — use only if you know what you're doing.
- Toast lifetime: How long status toasts stay on screen before auto-dismissing.
- Suppress info-severity toasts: When on, info toasts (status confirmations) are filtered out. Warnings + errors still show.
- Image Filter sound: Play a short chime when WP Image Filter is waiting for your pick, so you hear it from another tab.
- Image Filter desktop notification: Show a system notification when WP Image Filter is waiting and this tab is in the background. Your browser asks for permission the first time.
- Reduce motion: Disables Wildcard Pipeline animations. Match system honors prefers-reduced-motion.
- Contrast: Bumps borders + text contrast. Match system honors prefers-contrast.

sections.title: Test Runner
sections.text:
What a new Test Runner scenario starts with.
- Seed mode: Consecutive seeds, or a fresh random set on every run.
- First seed: Where a consecutive range starts.
- Number of seeds: How many prompts a run makes.

sections.title: AI assistant
sections.text:
Use your own model (Claude, OpenAI or a local server) to draft modules.
- Turn on the AI assistant: Adds the AI tools (editor panels, Describe, Organize, the chat and the Pack builder), using a model you already have.
- Provider: Who runs the model.
- Server address: Where the model server answers.
- API key: Saved on the ComfyUI machine and never shown again.
- Model: Which model the assistant uses.
- Model size: How much the assistant asks of the model: shorter instructions for small ones.
- Most context to use: The context the assistant asks Ollama for, in tokens.
- Unload the model after: Free the GPU for ComfyUI after a short idle.
- Thinking: Let a thinking model reason first, or ask it to answer straight away.
- Embedding server key: A key for an embedding server other than the chat's, sent only there.
- Tool format: How the chat calls its tools: native tool calls or the JSON step format.
- Embedding model: Meaning search: lets the chat find items by what they mean, not only their words. Off when empty.
- Embedding server type: Ollama or OpenAI-compatible, for an embedding server other than the chat's.
- Embedding server: Where the embedding model runs, when it isn't the chat's server. Its models are listed from there.
- Library index: The chat's search index of your library. Rebuild it if search seems off.
- Show Explain on selected text: A small Explain / Ask bar over text you select; Ctrl+Shift+X explains it without the bar.
- Let the assistant delete items: Lets the chat propose deleting items, categories and tags. Each delete still needs your confirm, and Undo brings it back.
- Apply small changes automatically: Descriptions, tags and categories from the chat apply without a click, with Undo.
- Web search: Let the chat search the web with SearXNG, Brave, Tavily or Kagi. Every search asks you first.
- SearXNG address: Your SearXNG server, with JSON output turned on.
- Search engine key: The Brave, Tavily or Kagi key, sent only to that engine.
- Read result pages: Let the chat read one page its search returned, after you allow it: built in, or your Crawl4AI or Firecrawl server.
- Page reader address: Your Crawl4AI or Firecrawl server.
- Page reader key: The Firecrawl key or Crawl4AI token, sent only to that server.
- Danbooru tag lookup: Let the chat look a tag up on Danbooru: wiki, aliases, implications and related tags. Each lookup asks first.
- Don't ask before web calls: Run web searches, page reads and Danbooru lookups without the Allow card.
- Test connection: Check the server answers and the model returns JSON, and see how much context a chat takes before you type.

sections.title: Library & data
sections.text:
Your module database, backups and maintenance.
- Database: File, size and what is in it.
- Automatic backups: Copy the database before every migration and once a day.
- Backups to keep: Older automatic backups are deleted.
- Backups: Back up now, restore, or delete a backup.
- Database location: Where the database file lives.
- Maintenance: Vacuum, integrity check, analyze, re-run migrations.

sections.title: Advanced
sections.text:
Move settings between machines, or start over.
- Export settings: Save every preference to a JSON file.
- Import settings: Load a settings file from another machine.
- Reset browser preferences: Clear this device's preferences. Your library is untouched.
